stem: Voltmarkt's paid search CPC is €0.90 and its display CPC is €0.30. What can the team conclude about which channel wins orders more cheaply?

options.text: Display, since a click costing a third as much means orders cost a third as much
Nothing yet, since CPC prices a click and says nothing about how often clicks buy
Paid search, since a dearer click always comes from a shopper with more intent to buy
Display, as long as both CPCs were measured over the same month and market
